title: APPROVAL OF FIRST AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 23-9996 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND AECOM TECHNICAL SERVICES, INC. FOR THE ENGINEERING AND ARCHITECTURAL SERVICES FOR THE PORT OF
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVAL OF FIRST AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 23-9996 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND AECOM TECHNICAL SERVICES, INC. FOR THE ENGINEERING AND ARCHITECTURAL SERVICES FOR THE PORT OF LOS ANGELES GOODS MOVEMENT WORKFORCE TRAINING FACILITY
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of a First Amendment to Agreement No. 23-9996 (Agreement) with AECOM Technical Services, Inc. (AECOM). The proposed First Amendment will extend the Agreement by five additional years to December 19, 2031, for a total of eight years, and increase compensation by $4,363,157 for a total of $14,140,298. The First Amendment is required at this time in order to accommodate relocation of the project site, from 1400 E. Anchorage Road to 300 S. Ferry Street and former Los Angeles Export Terminal (LAXT) site. The new project site will add project elements not included at the former location, which includes hazardous material and structural assessment of the former Customs House building; and construction of a pedestrian bridge, at grade rail crossing, and street improvements. This agreement is in alignment with the following Strategic Objectives: 1 - World Class Infrastructure that Promotes Growth (Initiative 1), and 4 - Strong Relationships with Stakeholders (Initiative 2).
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the First Amendment to extend Agreement No. 23-9996 with AECOM Technical Services, Inc. by five additional years, for a total of eight years and increase the compensation by $4,363,157 for a total of $14,140,298; 3) direct the Board Secretary to transmit the First Amendment to Agreement No. 23-9996 to the Los Angeles City Council for approval pursuant to Section 373 of the Charter of the City of Los Angeles and Section 10.5 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code; authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to said First Amendment for and on behalf of the Board of Harbor Commissioners; and adopt Resolution No.____________.
Construction Division
summary: The Port would extend its AECOM engineering contract to 2031 and add $4.36 million, bringing the total to $14.14 million, because the Goods Movement Workforce Training Facility is moving to a new site near Ferry Street.
